# Publish your podcast, audiobook or book yourself

> Free podcast RSS feed generator, Markdown to EPUB converter, ACX audiobook checker and KDP spine calculator. Runs in your browser, or as a CLI for AI agents.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/publish-kit/)
- [ACX audiobook requirements, and how to check your files before you upload](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/publish-kit/acx-audiobook-requirements.html)
